intent_summary: Callers can submit ordered numeric values or versioned requests containing datasets, settings, context, and declared relationships.

criteria.criterion: Ordered value lists work with separate settings, while schema 1.0 requests describe one dataset.
criteria.notes: Bare-list settings are validated; schema 1.0 limits datasets to exactly one.

criteria.criterion: Schema 1.1 datasets declare a nonempty entity scope and support explicit relationships between named datasets.
criteria.notes: Entity scope is required, relationship kinds are discriminated, and references must name distinct known datasets.

criteria.criterion: Unknown settings, unsupported recipes, nonfinite values, booleans, and numeric strings are rejected.
criteria.notes: Assertions reject each listed category; missing null values remain a separate accepted representation.

criteria.criterion: Published schema 1.0 and 1.1 request and result schemas match the public Python contracts.
criteria.notes: Tests and independent inspection compare each complete published schema with its contract-generated schema. Python cross-field validators supplement JSON Schema constraints.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
